name: Prudential Singapore
summary: Established insurer with health and protection plans commonly sold to residents, including post-PR hospital top-ups.
body: Work with an adviser who will put exclusions in writing. EP-year foreigner hospital plans and post-PR Integrated Shield Plans are different products — do not assume MediSave funding until you are SC/PR on MediShield Life. If you may leave Singapore in 2–3 years, ask about portability and surrender paths before you buy. Group medical from an employer usually ends on your last employment day and does not port to the next firm; price personal top-ups before elective care during a job hop.
